notes: Intro: HollowCrest is a mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app assistant). evaluating LLM for embedded assistant + search + code help.
Initial approach: ran Hosted API POC (Dec-Feb). Fast to integrate; latency OK for 95th perc but cost spikes on nightly batch re-ranks.
POC takeaways: embeddings + retriever gave strong relevancy; chat flows OK. But token costs + burst patterns during peak (EOD reports) pushed unit economics above target.
Current ask: Dedicated reserved capacity to get predictable TCO + VPC/network isolation for customer data. Will require SOC2/KMS and audit logs.
Pricing focus: negotiating commit levels (baseline qps), burst allowance, overage rate caps, and 3-6 month ramp schedule (growth expected 30% month-over-month first quarter).
Customer quote (AE paraphrase): "We need a hard cap on overage billing for first 3 months or else procurement won't sign."
Technical ask: ability to pin model family + automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant during capacity pressure. Also want prefix caching for nightly batch jobs.
Security notes: require SSO (SAML), KMS integration (customer-managed key), audit log export to their SIEM, and confirmation of NA data residency for primary EU customers (edge case).
Commercial posture: aggressive on committed ARR but needs flexible burst and step-up ramp to avoid over-commit. Interested in 12-month commit with quarterly checkpoints.
Internal risk: finance wants minimum 50% of projected usage covered in commit; eng wants conservative burst (2x baseline) then overage at predictable rate.
Docs shared: pricing deck + draft SOW (drive links above). Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-25 (see drive).
AE notes: SE demo 2026-02-12 showed Dedicated perf numbers; follow-up on kernel/quantization profile recommendations pending from runtime team.
Next negotiation items: firm tiers for commit (qps/token bands), pricing for burst (metered vs included), defined ramp schedule (months 0/3/6), and SLAs for latency at 99th percentile.
